en-US.desktop.remote.ports.title: Ports
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.help: A forwarded port listens only on this computer's loopback address (127.0.0.1). Every program on this computer can connect to it, not just Lithe. The host cannot reach this computer through it.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.localChanged: Port {requested} is in use on this computer, so {port} is used instead.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.addInvalid: Enter a port from 1 to 65535, host:port, or a URL such as http://localhost:3000.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.addCredentials: The address can't include a user name or password.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.empty: No ports are listening on the host. Type a port above to forward it anyway.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.disconnected: Not connected. Forwards end with the connection; forward the ports again after reconnecting.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.readFailed: Could not read the host's listening ports: {reason}
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.limit: This connection already forwards {maximum} ports, the most allowed. Stop one first.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.invalidTarget: The host or port is not valid.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.confirmBody: {target} is not the loopback address of {name}. Forwarding it lets every program on this computer reach that address through the host. Continue only if you trust it.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.localBody: Forward {remote} on {name} to this port of this computer's loopback address. If another program uses it, a free port is used instead and the row says so.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.localInvalid: Enter a port number from 1 to 65535.

zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.title: 端口
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.help: 转发的端口只监听本机的回环地址（127.0.0.1）。本机上的所有程序都能连接，不只是 Lithe；主机无法通过它反向访问本机。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.localChanged: 本机端口 {requested} 已被占用，改用 {port}。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.addInvalid: 请输入 1–65535 的端口、“主机:端口”，或 http://localhost:3000 这样的网址。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.addCredentials: 地址不能包含用户名或密码。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.empty: 主机上没有正在监听的端口。也可以在上方输入端口直接转发。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.loading: 正在读取主机上的监听端口…
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.disconnected: 未连接。转发随连接一起结束，重新连接后需要再次转发。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.readFailed: 无法读取主机上的监听端口：{reason}
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.limit: 此连接已转发 {maximum} 个端口，达到上限，请先停止一个。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.confirmBody: {target} 不是 {name} 自身的回环地址。转发后，本机上的所有程序都能经由主机访问这个地址。请确认你信任它后再继续。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.statusTooltip: 已转发 {count} 个端口，点击打开“端口”窗口。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.localBody: 把 {name} 上的 {remote} 转发到本机回环地址的这个端口。如果它已被其他程序占用，会改用一个空闲端口，并在这一行注明。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.localInvalid: 请输入 1 到 65535 之间的端口号。
